messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden increase in 5xx + timeouts on /v1/generate after deploy. p95 ~1.8s -> 2.9s, p99 ~3.1s, 5xx rate jumped to 5.8%. Rolling canary flagged. Paging oncall.
alex_oncall: I'm oncall — looking. Canary release id: release-20260210-rc3? @sam_infra can you surface last deploy diff? :eyes:
sam_infra: pulling diff now. quick glance: changed attention kernel selection + small batching tweak. nothing big in traffic shaping. logs show many upstream gateway timeouts (504) from internal proxy.
mike_sre: seeing the same in traces — KV cache misses up ~4x on canary nodes, seq length distribution looks normal. latency tail corresponds with higher backend connection wait times.
julia_prod: hold on customer impact — CS flagged 3 customers reporting delayed requests and timeouts. Not large scale but visible. prepping comms.
emma_support: posting initial banner to status.redwood.ai -> "Partial degradation affecting text generation; investigating". Will escalate if customer impact grows.
alex_oncall: plan: 1) cut traffic back to stable (90/10 -> 0/100) 2) triage on canary nodes 3) rollback if metrics don't recover in 5m. executing traffic shift now.
ops-lead: +1. If KV miss is root, might be warmup/affinity regression after kernel change. prefer rollback to be safe.
sam_infra: traffic shift started. canary -> 0% at LB. confirming routing: all canary pods drained.
mike_sre: after shift, 5xx drops to 1.2% but p99 still high for some in-flight reqs. looks like connection pool saturation on the canary hosts; draining helped.
alex_oncall: initiating rollback for release-20260210-rc3. rollback command: ```redwood deploy rollback --service=inference --to=release-20260210-rc2 --force```
sam_infra: running rollback now. watching deploy logs: pods terminating, previous replicas coming up.
incident-bot: ACTION: rollback job started by alex_oncall (job id jb-6178904321-rollback).
mike_sre: quick check: enabling edge circuit-breaker and reducing upstream timeout to 2s to prevent cascade while rollback completes: ```edgelbctl set timeout --service=inference --timeout-ms=2000```
julia_prod: CS notified affected customers with brief note. also capturing affected request IDs for follow-up.
emma_support: support thread created for the 3 customers, adding temporary credits offer if they request.
sam_infra: rollback completed, old pods at desired state. confirming metrics window.
alex_oncall: post-rollback metrics: p95 ~0.95s, p99 ~1.1s, 5xx ~0.3%. Looks good. marking mitigation succeeded.
incident-bot: NOTE: Automated runbook step complete: rollback succeeded. Recording timeline.
mike_sre: saving traces + KV stats for postmortem. copying sample trace ids: trace:tr-617890-1, tr-617890-2.
julia_prod: creating incident ticket and scheduling postmortem with SRE + Runtime + Product. tentative 1h postmortem.
ops-lead: action items: 1) revert kernel selection experiment branch and add warmup for KV cache 2) add load-test for kernel-switch paths 3) improve canary traffic ramp gating by KV miss metric.
emma_support: updating status page to resolved for the user-visible banner. leaving note: "Service performance restored after rollback; investigations ongoing."
alex_oncall: handing off to morning SRE team for post-incident follow-up. if anything regresses, re-open thread. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: root cause candidate = kernel selection combined with KV cache warmup regression on canary. Follow-up PM notes: postmortem in #incidents-pm.
